title: An Analysis of the New EU AI Act and A Proposed Standardization Framework for Machine Learning Fairness
benchmark_measurement: The paper proposes a framework to measure fairness in AI systems, where 'religion' is included as one of the protected attributes for which fairness should be quantified and made transparent.
findings: The paper does not present empirical findings on religious bias. Instead, it argues that 'religion' should be included as a protected attribute in its proposed standardization framework for AI fairness, transparency, and auditing, in line with definitions from the U.S. Equal Opportunity Commission.
